text:
Arjun Mehta: Heads up — Specter Analytics wants to sign by EOW and pushed for a Fri production window. Procurement emailed asking for final committed pricing, SOC2 attestation, SSO timeline, and VPC peering ETA. Can we triage blockers?

Clara Voss: I'll own the SOC2/attestation + legal addenda. Quick Q: do they need BYO KMS? Procurement hinted yes.

Diego Ramos: For infra I need their AWS account IDs + CIDR ranges for peering. If received today we can provision in ~48h; otherwise 3-5 business days. Also confirm whether they prefer VPC peering or PrivateLink.

Nora Patel: Finance request: they want a mid-tier commit at 750k tokens/mo and a top-tier at 3M. Can we share a conservative table so Procurement has something to review now?

Arjun Mehta: Draft pricing snippet (for Procurement review):
```
Starter: 0 - 100k tokens -> $0.005 / 1k tokens
Growth: 100k - 750k -> $0.0038 / 1k tokens
Committed: 750k - 3M -> $0.0024 / 1k tokens (commit discount applies)
Enterprise: 3M+ -> $0.0016 / 1k tokens + reserved capacity pricing
Reserved capacity note: Dedicated pool recommended for sustained >150 RPS.
```
Arjun Mehta: Finance still needs to sign off but this should keep procurement moving.

Clara Voss: Legal: SOC2 attestation OK. If they require BYO KMS we need them to sign the KMS addendum; I'll drop the attestation text and addendum link here in ~30m. No other legal showstoppers.

Diego Ramos: Peering blurb they can include (copyable):
```
Redwood Inference will restrict egress to customer-specified CIDR ranges via VPC peering or PrivateLink. We will not store customer data outside the designated regions. Provide account IDs and CIDRs to initiate peering. Estimated provisioning: ~48 hours after network addendum is signed and account details are shared.
```

Nora Patel: If they're aiming for Fri, timeline is tight. Action owners: Clara -> attestation + KMS addendum; Diego -> prepare peering runbook and estimate; Arjun -> get finance final numbers; I'll coordinate with Procurement. If 1+2 are ready by EOD we'll set a short exec sync.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Specter exec sync" 20m at 2025-03-25T16:00:00Z (created by Nora Patel).

Arjun Mehta: Sending the draft pricing to finance now.

Clara Voss: Posting SOC2 attestation and KMS addendum link.
